description.en: A typical galvanic cell consisting of zinc and copper electrodes dipping in ZnSO4 and CuSO4 solutions respectively.
description.hi: एक विशिष्ट गैल्वेनिक सेल जिसमें जिंक और कॉपर इलेक्ट्रोड क्रमशः ZnSO4 और CuSO4 विलयन में डूबे होते हैं।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 600 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Left Beaker (Anode) -->
  <path d="M 100 150 L 100 350 A 10 10 0 0 0 110 360 L 250 360 A 10 10 0 0 0 260 350 L 260 150" fill="none" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="3" />
  <path d="M 100 200 L 260 200" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="5,5" />
  <rect x="102" y="200" width="156" height="158" fill="#bfdbfe" opacity="0.5" />
  <text x="140" y="330" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" fill="#1d4ed8">ZnSO₄ (aq)</text>

  <!-- Right Beaker (Cathode) -->
  <path d="M 340 150 L 340 350 A 10 10 0 0 0 350 360 L 490 360 A 10 10 0 0 0 500 350 L 500 150" fill="none" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="3" />
  <path d="M 340 200 L 500 200" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="5,5" />
  <rect x="342" y="200" width="156" height="158" fill="#93c5fd" opacity="0.5" />
  <text x="380" y="330" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" fill="#1d4ed8">CuSO₄ (aq)</text>

  <!-- Zinc Electrode (Anode) -->
  <rect x="160" y="100" width="40" height="180" fill="#9ca3af" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="165" y="150" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">Zn</text>
  <text x="150" y="80" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#dc2626">Anode (-)</text>

  <!-- Copper Electrode (Cathode) -->
  <rect x="400" y="100" width="40" height="180" fill="#f87171" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="405" y="150" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">Cu</text>
  <text x="390" y="80" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#dc2626">Cathode (+)</text>

  <!-- Wire and Voltmeter -->
  <path d="M 180 100 L 180 50 L 280 50" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
  <path d="M 320 50 L 420 50 L 420 100" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
  <circle cx="300" cy="50" r="20" fill="#fff" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="293" y="56" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold">V</text>

  <!-- Electron Flow Arrow -->
  <path d="M 220 40 L 260 40 L 250 35 M 260 40 L 250 45" fill="none" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="230" y="30" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#dc2626">e⁻</text>

  <!-- Current Flow Arrow -->
  <path d="M 380 60 L 340 60 L 350 55 M 340 60 L 350 65" fill="none" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="350" y="80" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#16a34a">I</text>

  <!-- Salt Bridge -->
  <path d="M 230 250 L 230 140 A 20 20 0 0 1 270 140 L 270 160 A 10 10 0 0 0 250 160 L 250 250 Z" fill="#fef08a" stroke="#ca8a04" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.8" />
  <path d="M 370 250 L 370 140 A 20 20 0 0 0 330 140 L 330 160 A 10 10 0 0 1 350 160 L 350 250 Z" fill="#fef08a" stroke="#ca8a04" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.8" />
  <path d="M 250 140 L 350 140" fill="none" stroke="#ca8a04" stroke-width="20" opacity="0.8" />
  <text x="265" y="145" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#854d0e">Salt Bridge</text>

  <!-- Ions in solution -->
  <text x="180" y="270" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#1d4ed8">Zn²⁺ →</text>
  <text x="420" y="270" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#1d4ed8">← Cu²⁺</text>
</svg>
